label: Developmental trajectory (global)
description: Superordinate node: the person's overall developmental course; interfaces with all other UPG strata

label: Physical / Motor
description: Growth, motor milestones, puberty, aging; the body as developmental platform

label: Cognitive
description: Attention, memory, executive function, reasoning; constructivist stage sequence as canonical subgraph

label: Language
description: Phonology through pragmatics; paradigm case of sensitive-period gating

label: Emotional
description: Emotion expression, understanding, regulation; substrate for later self-regulation

label: Social / Relational
description: Attachment, peer relations, intimacy; internal working models as carried structure

label: Moral
description: Moral judgment and behavior; staged reorganization with social-cognitive inputs

label: Self / Identity
description: Self-concept, identity formation, narrative identity across psychosocial epochs

label: Caregiving / Attachment context
description: Proximal caregiving processes; interface node to the Systems stratum (Batch H)

label: Maturation
description: Genetically guided unfolding; canalization; edge-type generator

label: Learning
description: Conditioning, observational learning; experience-driven weight change

label: Construction
description: Assimilation-accommodation; stage-like reorganization of structures

label: Internalization
description: Social-to-individual transfer via scaffolding within the zone of proximal development

label: Transaction
description: Reciprocal person-environment co-regulation over time

label: Sensorimotor structures
description: Action-based schemes (canonical constructivist sequence, step 1)

label: Preoperational structures
description: Symbolic but intuition-bound thought (step 2)

label: Concrete operational structures
description: Logical operations on concrete content (step 3)

label: Formal operational structures
description: Hypothetico-deductive reasoning (step 4; not universally attained)

label: Attachment formation
description: Preattachment through clear-cut attachment; secure-base behavior

label: Internal working models
description: Carried relational expectations; bridge to personality and psychopathology strata

label: Peer competence
description: Peer acceptance, friendship quality; cascade hub in middle childhood
